name: Timothy Sullivan
bio: A Representative from New York; born in New York City July 23, 1862; attended public schools; businessman, real estate and theatrical; member of the New York state assembly, 1886-1894; member of the New York state senate 1894-1903, 1909-1912; elected as a Democrat to the Fifty-eighth and to the succeeding Congress (March 4, 1903-July 27, 1906); resigned on July 27, 1906; elected as a Democrat to the Sixty-third Congress in 1912, but never took his seat; struck and killed on August 31, 1913, by a locomotive near Pelham Parkway, New York, N.Y.; interment in Calvary Cemetery, Long Island City, N.Y.
